pull_request.head: codex/issue117-calorimeter-digitization
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Refs #117. Adds the calorimeter model survey and an isolated, opt-in Si–W digitization prototype that reuses pinned original MarlinReco energy methods. **The Marlin study and original-framework/physics validation remain deferred at the user's request until appropriate software is installed.** This draft does not close #117 or claim design acceptance. It also records the authorized raw-Geant4 nODD tiling/control response scan, which measures substantial local silicon-signal nonuniformity.

## Change

- Draft DES-044 compares existing models for Si–W, LAr, SiPM-on-tile HCAL and quartz-fibre FCAL, with pinned sources, framework coupling, licensing and μ=200 gaps.
- Connect the ACTS skeleton to the original silicon energy kernel through a separate GPL executable; preserve explicit position modes, deterministic event seeds and signal/noise provenance.
- Prepare a same-hit comparison utility and a source-verified Key4hep steering recipe for later execution.
- Characterize raw Geant4 electron response in the full positive nODD endcap against an idealized continuous-Si control, retaining physical tile gaps and common wedge seams.
- Retain reproduction recipes, project tracking and session evidence. Existing exploratory plots and compact binwise summaries are included; full ROOT samples, caches and run logs remain local.

## Raw nODD tiled-endcap electron response

Runs the **PR #115-derived nODD Si–W endcap**, all **48 layers × 16 positive-end wedges**, with absorber, readout hardware, cooling and supported frames. This is an isolated, zero-field endcap setup; other detector subsystems are absent. The idealized control replaces active/guard silicon with a continuous sensitive plane inside the same sensor-board envelope. It adds about **110 kg of Si** and makes guards active; hardware and mechanical wedge seams remain. This is a physical-layout/control comparison, with no pad-rebinning or full-detector qualification claim.

**7,600 bulk electrons:** 200 independent events per geometry/point; 13 positions at 20 GeV, plus 5/50 GeV at centre C, gap G and seam S. A separate 100-event continuous-C reference fixes one common low-signal cut. All events, including zeros, are retained.

At **20 GeV**:

| First-plane impact | Mean tiled / continuous Si energy | Reduction relative to control |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Square sensor centre C | 0.9058 ± 0.0041 | **9.4%** (±0.4 percentage points) |
| Intersensor gap G | 0.3458 ± 0.0021 | **65.4%** (±0.2 percentage points) |

Errors are Monte Carlo standard errors only. These deliberately selected points do not define an area-averaged detector loss. The straight unscattered G ray remains between sensors in all 48 layers; the shower still reaches neighbouring silicon. Across 5–50 GeV, C loses about 6–12% of the control signal and G about 65–66%.

[![nODD raw response, spatial mean ratios, spread and low-signal tails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-response.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-response.png)

[![nODD 20 GeV deposited-energy distributions at centre, gap, corner and seam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-spectra.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-spectra.png)

Raw RMS/mean describes the visible-energy distribution, **not reconstructed energy resolution**. Width errors use whole-event bootstrap; tails retain conditional Wilson95% intervals and a joint reference/sample bootstrap, with keyed covariance. Undefined zero-denominator quantities are null. No electronics noise, digitizer or Marlin processor is applied; the Marlin-study deferral remains active.

<details>
<summary>Longitudinal deposits at centre, gap and seam</summary>

[![nODD longitudinal silicon energy profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-longitudinal.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-longitudinal.png)

Marginal layer errors preserve the all-event denominator. Layers are correlated; escaping energy is not scored.

</details>

[Full results and reproduction recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/tiling-response.md) · [Frozen scan protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/tiling-response-plan.md) · [Compact histograms, moments and provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-response.json)

## Tiled nODD endcap — geometry restored by PR #115

**Correction:** the first endcap projection used the upstream ODD comparison detector. [PR #115](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/115) restored the tiled nODD Si–W endcap: **16 wedge carriers × 112 sensor modules per layer**, with **76 square + 36 custom edge sensors per wedge**. Square silicon is 90 mm across (88 mm active); pads have a nominal **5.5 × 5.5 mm** pitch. `sector` identifies the wedge; `module` identifies an individual sensor tile.

[![Corrected tiled nODD endcap with raw sensitive hits, sensor modules and custom pad zoom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-xy.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-xy.png)

**A:** full +z sensor-layout guide, 1,792 tiles per layer. **B:** raw Geant4 hit cell references on one wedge. **C/D:** square tile 27 beside custom tile 26, with the true custom pad polygons and merged edge pads. Pad colors sum raw hit entries over the three simulated layers.

The display fixture uses **512 simulated 10 GeV muons**, +z sector 0, layers 0–2, with unchanged PR #115 sensor masks, segmentation and local layer hardware. Illumination is deliberately stratified across the wedge and the two zoom tiles. Other sectors, layers, the opposite endcap and the supported wedge frame are omitted; the full-face panel is a geometry guide. White pads mean unhit in this sample. This is a segmentation display, with no efficiency or full-detector performance claim.

All ten geometry inputs match PR #115 head `14898df`; fresh component XML/material exports are byte-identical to the executed component. **1,231 saved hits / 1,001 occupied layer-pad bins / 87 modules**; every parent/pad ID matches the catalogue, and maximum stored-position residual is below 0.0001 mm. This separate raw-hit transport uses no digitization or Marlin. The Marlin-study deferral remains active.

[Compact layout/pad polygons](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-layout.json) · [Raw-hit bins and provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-hit-bins.json) · [Scope and reproduction recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/README.md#nodd-tiled-endcap--geometry-restored-by-pr-115)

<details>
<summary>Earlier upstream ODD digitization previews — before the Marlin deferral</summary>

## Existing exploratory previews

These electron/muon plots were prepared **before the Marlin-study deferral**. These two previews reuse saved upstream ODD summaries, with no new digitization or full-framework comparison. A separate raw-hit display fixture below uses the tiled nODD geometry. The original Marlin/Key4hep study remains deferred.

### Electron response and relative energy spread

[![Exploratory electron response and relative energy spread](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/response.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/response.png)

**Upstream ODD comparison geometry:** 200 electron events at each of 5, 20 and 50 GeV and η = 0, 1 and 2 (1,800 events). Energies are deposit-equivalent, with no shower calibration. RMS error bars use a Gaussian approximation; forward tails remain unqualified. The CALICE curve provides scale context for a different geometry, not a validation band.

### Held-out muon MIP spectrum

[![Held-out central muon MIP spectrum](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/mip.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/mip.png)

**Upstream ODD comparison geometry:** 250 held-out central 10 GeV muon events. The 148.75 keV MIP scale was frozen from a separate 250-event calibration sample. These are binned spectra, without a Landau–Gaussian fit or angular/systematic validation.

[Compact binwise data](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/binwise.json) · [Replotting recipe and limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/README.md#existing-exploratory-previews)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Earlier upstream ODD comparison view — continuous wedges and 5.1 mm virtual cells</summary>

This retained plot shows upstream ODD, **not the tiled nODD geometry restored by PR #115**.

[![Raw ECAL endcap sensitive-hit projection and readout-cell zoom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/ce609eb6cedf459594134d12994db01882f219fe/docs/validation/issue117/previews/endcap-xy.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/ce609eb6cedf459594134d12994db01882f219fe/docs/validation/issue117/previews/endcap-xy.png)

Saved 50 GeV electron sample, η = 2, φ = 0.123 rad, 200 events; +z endcap only. **Left:** 309,693 raw SimHit entries across 48 layers, projected into 20 mm display bins, with the 16 source module outlines. **Right:** layer 14, showing the **5.1 × 5.1 mm virtual readout cells** and the boundary/orientation change between modules **13 and 14**.

Cell centres were checked against the pinned geometry and signed cell indices, with maximum x/y/z residuals below 0.0001 mm. The zoom cells are clipped to the silicon-module footprints. Uncolored regions are unhit in this fixed-φ sample; this is a segmentation inspection, not an efficiency map. ODD models virtual cells inside silicon wedges rather than an individual-wafer tiling.

That earlier ODD projection reads saved simulation output; preparing it ran no new transport or digitization. The new nODD scan above is a separate raw-Geant4 study.

- [x] Full-positive-endcap native geometry checks, all 7,700 scan/reference events, six focused response-accounting regressions and independent numerical/PNG-reproduction checks passed.
- [x] Updated project tracking and retained DRAFT/PROTOTYPE approval boundaries; production geometry/layout inputs are unchanged; the alternative compact is an isolated study control.

issues.title: Calorimeter: select existing digitization models and validate a first implementation
issues.body:
## Goal
Reuse existing, validated calorimeter digitization models rather than writing our
own. Survey candidates for every calorimeter technology on `main`, then implement
and validate one end to end in the `CalorimeterDigitizationAlgorithm` skeleton.

Technologies: Si-W ECAL (DES-031), ALLEGRO-style LAr ECAL (DES-032/033),
steel/scintillator SiPM-on-tile HCAL (DES-036–038), W/quartz-fibre FCAL (DES-039).

## Starting leads (verify paths and versions)
- ATLAS Athena: `LArDigitization`, `LArROD` (OFC), `CaloTools` noise, `TileSimAlgs`
- CMS CMSSW: `HGCalSimProducers` (HGCDigitizer), HGCAL Si/scintillator noise maps,
  `HcalSimAlgos` (SiPM, HF), `SimG4CMS/Calo` (HF fibres)
- FCC-ee/Key4hep: `k4RecCalorimeter` (ALLEGRO cells, noise, calibration), HEP-FCC `dual-readout`
- ILD/CLIC: MarlinReco `DDCaloDigi`, `RealisticCaloDigiSilicon` / `RealisticCaloDigiScinPpd`
- EIC: EICrecon `CalorimeterHitDigi` (EDM4hep-native generic baseline)

ALLEGRO and ILD target low-pileup e+e−; note what each model needs for 14 TeV, μ=200
(pulse shape and out-of-time pileup for LAr, radiation-dependent noise for Si/SiPM).

## Scope
1. Survey: per technology, candidate model(s), effects covered (sampling fraction,
   Birks/photostatistics, SiPM saturation, noise, pulse shape, out-of-time pileup,
   ADC/ToA, thresholds), framework coupling and reuse effort.
2. Implement the recommended model for the **Si-W ECAL first**, using ODD's ECAL
   (same technology family) so it runs on existing ODD `ddsim` samples.
3. Validate:
   - **Unit:** noise-only events reproduce configured noise RMS and threshold rates;
     single muons give the expected MIP peak.
   - **Reference comparison:** same `ddsim` hits through the original implementation
     (e.g. Key4hep `DDCaloDigi` / `k4RecCalorimeter`) and ours agree.
   - **Physics:** single e/γ at several energies and η give sampling fraction,
     linearity and resolution consistent in scale with published Si-W results.

The EDM4hep input converter currently needs a cellID → cell-centre lookup; `ddsim`
hits already carry the cell position, so an option to use it is in scope.

The Si-W implementation is a **PROTOTYPE** until the DES is signed off.

## Done when
- [ ] DES draft recommending one model per technology, with references and open questions
- [ ] Si-W ECAL digitization implemented with unit and reference-comparison tests passing
- [ ] Single-particle response plots with recipe (binwise outputs only, per ADR-003)
- [ ] Follow-up issues listed for the remaining technologies

## Executive summary

Refs #117. Adds the calorimeter model survey and an isolated, opt-in Si–W digitization prototype that reuses pinned original MarlinReco energy methods. **The Marlin study and original-framework/physics validation remain deferred at the user's request until appropriate software is installed.** This draft does not close #117 or claim design acceptance. It also records the authorized raw-Geant4 nODD tiling/control response scan, which measures substantial local silicon-signal nonuniformity.

## Change

- Draft DES-044 compares existing models for Si–W, LAr, SiPM-on-tile HCAL and quartz-fibre FCAL, with pinned sources, framework coupling, licensing and μ=200 gaps.
- Connect the ACTS skeleton to the original silicon energy kernel through a separate GPL executable; preserve explicit position modes, deterministic event seeds and signal/noise provenance.
- Prepare a same-hit comparison utility and a source-verified Key4hep steering recipe for later execution.
- Characterize raw Geant4 electron response in the full positive nODD endcap against an idealized continuous-Si control, retaining physical tile gaps and common wedge seams.
- Retain reproduction recipes, project tracking and session evidence. Existing exploratory plots and compact binwise summaries are included; full ROOT samples, caches and run logs remain local.

## Raw nODD tiled-endcap electron response

Runs the **PR #115-derived nODD Si–W endcap**, all **48 layers × 16 positive-end wedges**, with absorber, readout hardware, cooling and supported frames. This is an isolated, zero-field endcap setup; other detector subsystems are absent. The idealized control replaces active/guard silicon with a continuous sensitive plane inside the same sensor-board envelope. It adds about **110 kg of Si** and makes guards active; hardware and mechanical wedge seams remain. This is a physical-layout/control comparison, with no pad-rebinning or full-detector qualification claim.

**7,600 bulk electrons:** 200 independent events per geometry/point; 13 positions at 20 GeV, plus 5/50 GeV at centre C, gap G and seam S. A separate 100-event continuous-C reference fixes one common low-signal cut. All events, including zeros, are retained.

At **20 GeV**:

| First-plane impact | Mean tiled / continuous Si energy | Reduction relative to control |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Square sensor centre C | 0.9058 ± 0.0041 | **9.4%** (±0.4 percentage points) |
| Intersensor gap G | 0.3458 ± 0.0021 | **65.4%** (±0.2 percentage points) |

Errors are Monte Carlo standard errors only. These deliberately selected points do not define an area-averaged detector loss. The straight unscattered G ray remains between sensors in all 48 layers; the shower still reaches neighbouring silicon. Across 5–50 GeV, C loses about 6–12% of the control signal and G about 65–66%.

[![nODD raw response, spatial mean ratios, spread and low-signal tails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-response.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-response.png)

[![nODD 20 GeV deposited-energy distributions at centre, gap, corner and seam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-spectra.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/97ba1015c1c3616d854e45be638d93d2d358160b/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiling-spectra.png)

Raw RMS/mean describes the visible-energy distribution, **not reconstructed energy resolution**. Width errors use whole-event bootstrap; tails retain conditional Wilson95% intervals and a joint reference/sample bootstrap, with keyed covariance. Undefined zero-denominator quantities are null. No electronics noise, digitizer or Marlin processor is applied; the Marlin-study deferral remains active.

## Tiled nODD endcap — geometry restored by PR #115

**Correction:** the first endcap projection used the upstream ODD comparison detector. [PR #115](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/115) restored the tiled nODD Si–W endcap: **16 wedge carriers × 112 sensor modules per layer**, with **76 square + 36 custom edge sensors per wedge**. Square silicon is 90 mm across (88 mm active); pads have a nominal **5.5 × 5.5 mm** pitch. `sector` identifies the wedge; `module` identifies an individual sensor tile.

[![Corrected tiled nODD endcap with raw sensitive hits, sensor modules and custom pad zoom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-xy.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-xy.png)

**A:** full +z sensor-layout guide, 1,792 tiles per layer. **B:** raw Geant4 hit cell references on one wedge. **C/D:** square tile 27 beside custom tile 26, with the true custom pad polygons and merged edge pads. Pad colors sum raw hit entries over the three simulated layers.

The display fixture uses **512 simulated 10 GeV muons**, +z sector 0, layers 0–2, with unchanged PR #115 sensor masks, segmentation and local layer hardware. Illumination is deliberately stratified across the wedge and the two zoom tiles. Other sectors, layers, the opposite endcap and the supported wedge frame are omitted; the full-face panel is a geometry guide. White pads mean unhit in this sample. This is a segmentation display, with no efficiency or full-detector performance claim.

All ten geometry inputs match PR #115 head `14898df`; fresh component XML/material exports are byte-identical to the executed component. **1,231 saved hits / 1,001 occupied layer-pad bins / 87 modules**; every parent/pad ID matches the catalogue, and maximum stored-position residual is below 0.0001 mm. This separate raw-hit transport uses no digitization or Marlin. The Marlin-study deferral remains active.

These electron/muon plots were prepared **before the Marlin-study deferral**. These two previews reuse saved upstream ODD summaries, with no new digitization or full-framework comparison. A separate raw-hit display fixture below uses the tiled nODD geometry. The original Marlin/Key4hep study remains deferred.

[![Exploratory electron response and relative energy spread](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/response.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/response.png)

[![Held-out central muon MIP spectrum](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/mip.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/01da03456fcfc107992f3b955d0ffaf0449c5c82/docs/validation/issue117/previews/mip.png)

## Goal
Reuse existing, validated calorimeter digitization models rather than writing our
own. Survey candidates for every calorimeter technology on `main`, then implement
and validate one end to end in the `CalorimeterDigitizationAlgorithm` skeleton.

Technologies: Si-W ECAL (DES-031), ALLEGRO-style LAr ECAL (DES-032/033),
steel/scintillator SiPM-on-tile HCAL (DES-036–038), W/quartz-fibre FCAL (DES-039).

## Starting leads (verify paths and versions)
- ATLAS Athena: `LArDigitization`, `LArROD` (OFC), `CaloTools` noise, `TileSimAlgs`
- CMS CMSSW: `HGCalSimProducers` (HGCDigitizer), HGCAL Si/scintillator noise maps,
  `HcalSimAlgos` (SiPM, HF), `SimG4CMS/Calo` (HF fibres)
- FCC-ee/Key4hep: `k4RecCalorimeter` (ALLEGRO cells, noise, calibration), HEP-FCC `dual-readout`
- ILD/CLIC: MarlinReco `DDCaloDigi`, `RealisticCaloDigiSilicon` / `RealisticCaloDigiScinPpd`
- EIC: EICrecon `CalorimeterHitDigi` (EDM4hep-native generic baseline)

ALLEGRO and ILD target low-pileup e+e−; note what each model needs for 14 TeV, μ=200
(pulse shape and out-of-time pileup for LAr, radiation-dependent noise for Si/SiPM).

## Scope
1. Survey: per technology, candidate model(s), effects covered (sampling fraction,
   Birks/photostatistics, SiPM saturation, noise, pulse shape, out-of-time pileup,
   ADC/ToA, thresholds), framework coupling and reuse effort.
2. Implement the recommended model for the **Si-W ECAL first**, using ODD's ECAL
   (same technology family) so it runs on existing ODD `ddsim` samples.
3. Validate:
   - **Unit:** noise-only events reproduce configured noise RMS and threshold rates;
     single muons give the expected MIP peak.
   - **Reference comparison:** same `ddsim` hits through the original implementation
     (e.g. Key4hep `DDCaloDigi` / `k4RecCalorimeter`) and ours agree.
   - **Physics:** single e/γ at several energies and η give sampling fraction,
     linearity and resolution consistent in scale with published Si-W results.

The EDM4hep input converter currently needs a cellID → cell-centre lookup; `ddsim`
hits already carry the cell position, so an option to use it is in scope.

The Si-W implementation is a **PROTOTYPE** until the DES is signed off.

## Done when
- [ ] DES draft recommending one model per technology, with references and open questions
- [ ] Si-W ECAL digitization implemented with unit and reference-comparison tests passing
- [ ] Single-particle response plots with recipe (binwise outputs only, per ADR-003)
- [ ] Follow-up issues listed for the remaining technologies

and GeoSvc sources are unchanged; a narrow CMake wrapper omits unrelated
reconstruction/simulation packages. The shared Spack environment is unchanged.
The source/build/runtime recipe, compact runtime hashes and source catalogue
are reviewable in PR123. Current missing-runtime blocker is resolved; the ODD
comparison and physics gates remain open. No geometry, response parameter,
calibration, design sign-off or physics acceptance changes.

Explicit SoftEng fallback assignments produced a dependency-closure review and
the initial smoke script. The coordinator reconciled and executed it, corrected
activation/fixture issues and owns the final result. No native profile loading
or separate physics review is claimed. Their separately exposed exact token

### Build and smoke corrections retained

- Boost CMake first returned1 because Python is opt-in; enable
  `BOOST_ENABLE_PYTHON=ON`. Boost then built and installed successfully.
- Gaudi v41 configure first returned1 because its optional ZSTD finder requires
  absent pkg-config; disable the unused optional Gaudi ZSTD feature. Spack's
  own zstd and ROOT/podio capabilities are unchanged.
- Gaudi compilation then returned1 with range-v3 0.12.0's nonportable standard
  forward declarations against current libc++. Pin upstream commit
  `5ba39112d2eafbb3c851a16a537f29b445022998`, which contains the compatibility
  correction; no local source patch. Reinstalled headers, then Gaudi built.
- `make key4hep JOBS=12` returned0, compiling/installing the full selected stack.
  Later k4FWCore/reference stages were reinstalled with explicit shared
  `GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR=python` and `GAUDI_INSTALL_PLUGINDIR=lib` because
  downstream defaults differed from the existing Gaudi install layout.
- Smoke1: Make returned2, original command1, missing k4FWCore Python module.
  The explicit install layout above fixes that mismatch.
- Smoke2: original command1, DD4hep could not find the XML-reader factory.
  The protected macOS shell stripped DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH; restore Spack's paths
  from DD4HEP_LIBRARY_PATH inside the runtime shell before launching Python.
- A standalone DD4hep diagnostic reached material parsing, then aborted134;
  smoke3 with restored paths reached the same hand-written fixture-material
  failure (original command139, Make2). These failures did not involve a
  production detector or algorithm-source change.
- Replaced that hand-written material fixture with copied, hashed installed
  DD4hep element/material catalogues. Smoke4 stopped before processor execution
  because thisdd4hep.sh is not an executable discoverable by shutil.which; use
  the verified DD4hepINSTALL environment instead. Make returned2.
- Final actual command:
  `make key4hep-test KEY4HEP_TEST_WORK="$PWD/build/key4hep-smoke-5"` returned0.
  Two events, two input cells, one accepted, one rejected and one empty event.
  Accepted energy exactly2 MIP, residual0 against the predeclared2e-6 MIP

  and terminated successfully. Compact receipt in
  `docs/validation/issue117/pr123-runtime.json`; full ROOT/logs remain ignored.
